The only handshakes are between a witch and a sorcerer, so the count is 6 × 10 = 60.

- Solution 1 gets 30 by wrongly halving 60. The witch-side count and the sorcerer-side count are the same set of handshakes, not two separate sets, so there is nothing to divide.
- Solution 2 gets 120 by adding the witch-side and sorcerer-side counts, which counts every handshake twice.
- Solution 3 gets 111 by subtracting handshakes between sorcerers, which never happened.

None of them reaches 60.

CHOICE: NONE
